_comment: Minimum IAM policy for the ps-mcp S3 tools. There is no bucket allowlist in
the server: this policy IS the security boundary, so scope it tightly.
Replace BUCKET and PREFIX, then attach to the IAM user ps-mcp runs as.
Drop the s3:DeleteObject action if the s3_delete tool should be inert.

If the bucket has SSE-KMS default encryption, uploads ALSO need kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt on the bucket's key, or s3_put fails with AccessDenied on kms:GenerateDataKey. Uncomment the KmsForSseKms statement below and set the key ARN.
